{{Quote|The Borokii overclan you seek lies but a few days' ride north of here, but you won't get to meet with them. Instead, we've embarked on a leisurely journey to the city of Dashbalar, where my clan always does good business.|Baiuntu|<ref name="AS">''[[The Approaching Storm]]''</ref>}}
'''Dashbalar''' was a city on the planet of [[Ansion/Legends|Ansion]] in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]. Dashbalar was a favored trading center of the native [[Qulun]] clan.<ref name="AS" />
